scene.note: Every request now passes Hesper's middleware on its way to the handler, and every error goes to one place.

steps.note: A member of staff changes the status of an order. The route is found and the body read.
handle runs the middleware in the order it was added. Each one decides whether the next runs.
The staff check finds the key and calls next(), so the handler changes the order.
handle finishes only once the whole chain has. Without the key, the staff check would have answered and nothing after it would run.
A customer asks for an order number that does not exist.
The handler throws an error that says there is no such order.
Everything left is skipped, and the error goes to the one error handler, which answers.
If there were no error handler, the router would answer that something went wrong, and nothing more.
A customer asks for the proof of an order, a route Sefton has not finished.
The proof handler returns without answering.
handle sees the step finish with no answer and no next(), so it knows who stopped.
Instead of spinning all afternoon, the page gets an answer that names the route that stopped.
